newsitem.title: USA: CME live and feeder cattle called steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: CME live and feeder cattle called steady to lower.

text.p: CME live cattle futures were expected to open steady to 0.200 cent a lb lower while feeder cattle were called steady to 0.150 lower, analysts said.

Some analysts look for carryover short covering after meeting chart support Tuesday. Ideas the cash cattle market may be near a bottom could also lend support after commercial buying late Tuesday, they said.
However, most analysts expected renewed pressure following the break in boxed beef values and expectations boxed prices will be lower again Wednesday.
Boxed beef prices fell $1.86 to $1.03 per cwt Tuesday with heavyweigh choice down to $99.63, lowest level in 9-week lows.
